_note: Overworld recolour for BC, applied by atlas/recolor_tiles.py to every tileset palette (data/tilesets/**/palettes/*.pal), starting from upstream. Each entry maps an exact upstream colour to a new one, so tiles from different tilesets still meet without seams.

colors._grass: Hoenn's bright mint grass becomes a cooler, mossy coast green.
colors._trees: Round lime tree crowns become darker conifer greens.
colors._water: Tropical blue water becomes a deeper Pacific blue.
